title: run-item.mjs: refuse an operator reseat of the planner to agy_google before spending a scout turn, instead of failing two minutes later on an argparse error
question: The Antigravity seat's turn helper maps a run's purpose to one of the Antigravity CLI agent's role names: "critique" to "reviewer", "scout" to "scout", and "plan" to "planner". But scripts/agy-seat.py's own argument parser only accepts --role in {reviewer, scout, fact-checker} -- there is no "planner" role, and never has been (no .agents/agents/pantheon-planner/ agent card exists either). An operator who reseats the planner chair to agy_google therefore always pays for a full intake (two independent scout turns, roughly two minutes of real vendor time) before the plan stage's agy_google turn fails with an argparse usage error (exit 2), because nothing checks the combination is even possible until the moment it is attempted. This was observed for real on 2026-09-28. What is the smallest change that reports this refusal immediately, before any turn is spent, without inventing a planner capability for the Antigravity seat that does not exist?
constraints: ES module syntax; Node built-ins only; no new dependencies
every existing export of run-item.mjs keeps its name and behaviour
the refusal must happen before any turn is spent: no scout, plan, or other vendor call may occur when seatOverrides.planner.vendor is "agy_google"
OVERRIDES.reviewer and OVERRIDES.implementer reseated to agy_google are unaffected
forbidden: do not elect a vendor as judge
do not edit any test file
do not edit scripts/agy-seat.py, .agents/, docs/, or any file other than src/board/run-item.mjs
do not add a "planner" role to the Antigravity seat; that is a distinct, larger change this ticket does not authorize
